items.headline: Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline
items.summary: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers. Just over 60M SF of retail is under construction, 4% above the all-time low CoStar has recorded, while JLL put Q2 vacancy at 4.4% and net absorption at 10.2M SF. Retailers such as Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Dollar Tree plan large store expansions, but flat rents and rising costs mean limited new supply to absorb them.…

Fairbourne and AEW are modernizing the 747K SF Arlington Highlands, which only recently slipped below 96% leased, while opportunity zones along Collins Street target the gap between downtown and the stadiums.…

items.headline: British Luxury Fashion Brand JW Anderson to Open at SoHo’s 138 Wooster Street
items.summary: British luxury fashion label JW Anderson has leased 4,500 square feet at 138 Wooster Street in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood for its first stand-alone U.S. store, Commercial Observer has learned. Founded in 2008 by Jonathan Anderson — the newly appointed creative director of Dior and a two-time British Fashion Awards Designer of the Year recipient — the influential fashion label is staking out a claim in a highly sought-after part of SoHo at a time when quality retail space in the neighborhood is increasingly…

The 273,050-square-foot property, owned by RK Centers , sits west of Interstate 95 at 750 Ives Dairy Road .…

items.headline: Luxury Spending Falls 6%, Raising Risks for High-End Retail
items.summary: Citi says U.S. luxury credit card spending fell 6% year over year in September, after 4% declines in both July and August, challenging a source of strength for luxury retail. Higher earners drive demand: Moody’s Analytics found households earning about $250,000 or more account for 49.7% of consumer spending, up from roughly 36% three decades earlier. The data does not show falling rents or occupancy yet, but landlords with luxury tenants have reason to watch tenant performance as consumer confidence weakens.…

items.headline: Retail Sales Jump 6% in August, Boosting CRE Property Demand
items.summary: Retail sales rose 6% year-over-year in August 2026 and have averaged 5.2% growth year-to-date, a pace historically uncommon outside post-recession recoveries. Households remain financially healthy overall, as rising incomes and record savings offset auto, credit card and household debt sitting at or near record highs. items.headline: Westwood Financial Pays $56M for Huntington Beach, Calif., Shopping Center
items.summary: Westwood Financial has bagged a grocery-anchored shopping center in Huntington Beach, Calif., for approximately $56.2 million, adding one of Orange County’s tightly held coastal retail properties to its portfolio. Real estate giant Blackstone sold the 95,416-square-foot Peninsula Marketplace for about $589 per square foot, according to records with PropertyShark . JLL announced the deal Thursday but declined to disclose the name of the seller or the value of the deal.…

items.summary: Lower Manhattan’s South Street Seaport will be living la dolce vita with its latest restaurant lease. Casa Serra , a sister restaurant to East Village eatery House of Pasta , has inked a 2,824-square-foot lease at the Durst Organization ’s 227 Front Street , the landlord announced Tuesday. The 15-year lease has an asking rent of $100 per square foot.…

items.headline: Corporate QSR Cap Rates Sit 97 Bps Below Franchisee Deals
items.summary: Corporate QSR asking cap rates reached 5.90% in Q3 2026, versus 6.87% for franchisee properties, a 97-basis-point gap that narrowed slightly from 100 basis points in Q2. The pricing premium appears in every lease-duration band, widest at 100 basis points for leases with 20 or more years remaining and 70 basis points for shorter terms.…

items.headline: Men’s Grooming Club John Allan’s Moves to 4 East 46th Street
items.summary: A men’s grooming and hair brand is moving its flagship location to Midtown East. John Allan’s signed a 3,000-square-foot lease at Jeong Hoon Kim ’s 4 East 46th Street , where it will provide an exclusive experience for its members in a relocation from 575 Fifth Avenue , according to tenant broker CBRE . The length of the lease was not disclosed, but asking rent for the building was $60 per square foot, according to CBRE.…
